title: Production SRE Deep Health Telemetry, Edge CDN Cache Purge & Traffic Telemetry
objective: Implement Cloudflare CDN cache-purge automation, deep system health telemetry probe (/api/health/deep), and production traffic observability metrics.
in_scope: Add Cloudflare CDN cache-purge service in server/services/cdnPurgeService.ts for edge cache invalidation.
Add deep health probe in server/routes/health.ts returning memory RSS, event loop lag, and durable database metrics.
Verify with npx tsc --noEmit and npm run build.
out_of_scope: Modifying core curriculum lattice or lesson progression rules.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/health/deep returns HTTP 200 with system memory RSS, uptime, and database storage telemetry.
CDN cache-purge adapter supports automated URL/tag purging with graceful offline fallback.
Automated SRE telemetry test passes 100% of assertions.
Zero TypeScript errors and clean production build.
risks: Cloudflare API token rate limits (mitigated by batching purge requests).
